invalid_predecessor.failure: V1 declared 12 heads for the frozen 9-head model and failed on index 9 before any result or scientific score was written.
invalid_predecessor.repair: Enumerate the authoritative head inventory 0-8, assert model.config.n_head equals 9 immediately after load, and adjust only arm-count price fields.

population: The unchanged sealed 64 A1/A2 will/had rows in two 32-row construction batches.

interventions.destinations: Only the determiner and head noun immediately after the temporal cue.
interventions.arms: Nine fixed singleton heads 0-8, all nine heads, and direct post-c_proj output replacement.
interventions.closure: All-head and direct-output selected logits must agree within 1e-4.

predictions.pred_a_authority_capability_exact_head_i: All authorities and capability hold; model head count is exactly 9; native replay and all-head/direct-output closure are within 1e-4; every arm-row is finite and present.
predictions.pred_b_material_attention_branch_recurre: The all-head arm has mean recovery at least 0.10 in A1 and 0.06 in A2, with donorward fraction at least 0.75 in both.
predictions.pred_c_shared_single_head_concentration: At least one identical head has singleton mean recovery at least half of all-head recovery and donorward fraction at least 0.75 in both A1 and A2.
predictions.pred_d_complete_head_ranking_reported: Report all nine singleton effects and their shared passing intersection without adaptive subset search.
predictions.pred_e_exact_zero_fit_price: Exactly 26 model forwards, 832 example evaluations, 704 arm-row records, and zero fits/searches/backwards/updates.

terminal.screen: A-E pass. Promote the shared singleton head for exact source-token partition.
terminal.null: A, B, and E pass but no shared singleton head passes C; classify the material writer as distributed at singleton resolution.
terminal.invalid: The repaired inventory assertion, authority, capability, replay, closure, materiality, finiteness, coverage, or price fails.

scope: V2 changes only the erroneous static head inventory and its mechanically implied price. Scientific hypotheses, bars, population, destinations, and causal operator are unchanged.
